meta.for: ISP Group LLC (US trader; CN/IN/TR water-treatment chemicals)
meta.purpose: Locally registered bidders/distributors able to bid national-only or local-presence tenders, with ISP as their supplier
meta.method: Parallel web search + direct fetch of official award notices: ARMP Cameroon (CAMWATER decisions 0093/2026 and 1900/2024), Blantyre Water Board tender results 2022-2026, City of Cape Town / Stellenbosch / Drakenstein / Bergrivier award lists, tenders-sa.org (ERWAT), GranTender supplier rankings (ANAC/TED/PLACSP/BZP/KBA-derived) for IT/ES/PL/HU/FI; contacts from company sites and business registries/directories.
meta.verification_rule: verified=true only if BOTH email and phone confirmed in two independent sources (company site + registry/directory/award doc); otherwise per-field verified_email/verified_phone. Never invented; null where not found.
meta.sanctions: No partner is a known sanctioned party; no SDN/EU/UN hits known for these names, but formal screening was NOT run in this pass - screen before any contract (esp. AFCOTT/Kewalram Chanrai group, Synergy Chemicals' GCC links, Chilmund (Zimbabwe)).
meta.excluded: SNF, Kemira, Feralco, Brenntag, Univar, Kemipol (PL producer/competitor), Chimitex (wins mostly urea/AdBlue), Bassau (pool only).
gaps: Cameroon: MEDINOV, Mawen, MOLA/AMN, NEO-PREN have no public email/phone - need CAMWATER DAJM/ARMP or in-person in Douala before 07.12.2026
Rwanda (WASAC): no locally registered chemical distributor with evidence found
Mauritius CWA, Ghana GWL, SODECI, SEN'EAU, FIPAG, AAWSA, Zambia (ZPPA) award data require portal login - no award evidence
Malawi BWB/LWB winners have no online contacts
Many EU emails/phones only on company site (single source) - see per-field flags
